Title: Provide Protection at ~mission(Location)
DisplayTitle: Provide Protection at Asteroid Mining Base
Description:
I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at <EM4>~mission(Location|Address)</EM4> comm'd to let me know that their  <EM>~mission(Objects)</EM4> are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any <EM4>friendly ships</EM4> unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you. 

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor <EM4>~mission(ScripAmount) Council Scrip</EM4> just to show my appreciation. 

Stows out.
